title: A ROUND THAT BREAKS A WRECK NO LONGER BOUNCES OFF IT
why: A glancing shot of yours off a metal wreck bounces once. When that same shot was the one that broke the wreck, the wreck vanished but the shot still bounced off the empty space and could hit a man behind it for more than half its damage. Proven in the cloud: a healthy wreck bounced the shot, and the shot that broke the wreck bounced too, off nothing. Now a shot bounces only off a wreck that is still there; the shot that breaks it carries on through the gap as it did before bouncing existed. Shots off a standing wreck are unchanged.
now: A shot that breaks a wreck no longer bounces off the empty space where the wreck was.
